description: Records a grammar mistake from a target-language sentence the user wrote, as a grammar point in their MindDory deck (shown on the Grammar Patterns page at app.minddory.com/grammar). Takes the original text, the correction and an error_type: tense, agreement, word_choice, word_order, article, preposition, spelling, pluralization, conjugation, gender or other. One call records one mistake. `lang` takes the full BCP-47 variant (en-gb, pt-br) so the mistake is filed under the user's regional variant.

error_type.description: One of: tense, agreement, word_choice, word_order, article, preposition, spelling, pluralization, conjugation, gender, other.

user_text.description: The exact erroneous sentence/phrase the user wrote.

name: capture_grammar_mistake
title: Capture grammar mistake
